title: Shady Nook
wikitext:
[[File:The Shady Nook.jpg|thumb|The Shady Nook]]

'''The Shady Nook''' is located in [[Ashenvale]], south of [[Raynewood Retreat]] and east of [[Greenpaw Village]]. It is a small valley populated by a small family of [[bear]]s, who presumably also inhabit the small cave located there.
